//watchPatterns: Without this, every push to main redeploys this service — including
backend-only commits that cannot change a single byte it serves. 367 of
the 408 commits in this repo never touch landing/, so the overwhelming
majority of this service's rebuilds have been wasted.
src/backend/assets/analytics.js is listed on purpose even though it lives
outside landing/. The landing site loads that file at runtime from the app
(see the Script tag in app/layout.tsx) rather than bundling it, so a change
there does not require rebuilding this service at all. It is here as a
tripwire: if that file ever becomes a build-time import, this pattern is
already correct instead of silently serving a stale event map.
Patterns are repo-root relative. Verify on the next backend-only merge:
this service should report no new deployment.
